title: l4-topology-envelope contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-493, ADR-0071). The SHAPE of the L4 topology-write-authority envelope verdict: a producer-emitted {op, verdict} pair which `faff contract l4-topology-envelope` re-derives from `op` via the ADR-0071 decision table and validates the declared `verdict` conforms (consumer-side conformance, mirroring prdr-admission). NO safe coerce target — an out-of-enum op.kind/level/provenance or verdict.disposition is a fail-loud, never coerced. The load-bearing invariant (the declared verdict matches the decision table's derivation for the given op) is enforced in code as a conformance violation; it is not expressible in this shape schema.
